meta.title: Lighter.xyz Data Adapter Skeleton & Asset Discovery
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Create the LighterDataAdapter class that can discover available assets on Lighter.xyz for users to explore and select tradeable pairs.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: LighterDataAdapter class exists extending BaseDataAdapter ABC
Asset discovery returns list of all trading pairs with symbol, base, quote, category
Asset filtering by category (perp/spot) and pattern matching supported
Asset data matches Lighter.xyz API response format

architecture-context.pattern: Follow existing data adapter patterns (CCXTDataAdapter, PolygonAdapter)
architecture-context.constraint: Use async/await for all I/O operations

nfr-references.nfr: 1 year of daily data fetch in less than 30 seconds
